## Introduction
This is a data analysis of the Billboard Hot 100.


```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
``` 

```{r}
#| cache: true
billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
billboard |> 
  select(artist, track, date.entered, wk1:wk4)
```

```{r}
summary(billboard$date.entered)
```

```{r}
ggplot(billboard, aes(x = wk1)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10) +
  labs(subtitle = paste("Number of values:", sum(!is.na(billboard$wk1))))
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  summarise(across(
    c(wk1, wk4, wk10, wk20, wk40, wk76),
    list(
      present = \(x) sum(!is.na(x)),
      missing = \(x) sum(is.na(x))
    )
  )) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("week", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(wk\\d+)_(present|missing)"
  )
```

```{r}
billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank"
  ) |>
  mutate(week = readr::parse_number(week))

ggplot(
  billboard_long,
  aes(x = week, y = rank, group = interaction(artist, track))
) +
  geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_y_reverse()
```

```{r}
billboard_long |>
  filter(!is.na(rank)) |>
  group_by(artist, track) |>
  filter(week == max(week)) |>
  filter(week == 20) |>
  ungroup() |>
  summarise(
    songs = n(),
    ranked_below_50 = sum(rank > 50),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
song_summary <- billboard_long |>
  filter(!is.na(rank)) |>
  arrange(artist, track, week) |>
  group_by(artist, track) |>
  summarise(
    first_rank = first(rank),
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_week_at_best = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    weeks_on_chart = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

song_summary
```

```{r}
number_one_songs <- song_summary |>
  filter(best_rank == 1)

top_ten_songs <- song_summary |>
  filter(best_rank <= 10)

notable_songs <- bind_rows(
  number_one_songs |>
    slice_min(first_week_at_best, n = 1, with_ties = TRUE) |>
    mutate(notable = "Fastest to No. 1"),
  number_one_songs |>
    slice_max(first_week_at_best, n = 1, with_ties = TRUE) |>
    mutate(notable = "Slowest to No. 1"),
  top_ten_songs |>
    slice_max(weeks_on_chart, n = 1, with_ties = TRUE) |>
    mutate(notable = "Longest chart run among top 10")
) |>
  select(notable, artist, track, first_rank, best_rank, first_week_at_best, weeks_on_chart)

notable_songs
```

```{r}
top_ten_plot_data <- billboard_long |>
  filter(!is.na(rank)) |>
  inner_join(top_ten_songs |> select(artist, track), by = c("artist", "track")) |>
  left_join(
    notable_songs |>
      transmute(artist, track, highlight = paste(artist, track, sep = " - ")),
    by = c("artist", "track")
  ) |>
  mutate(highlight = coalesce(highlight, "Other top-10 songs"))

ggplot(
  top_ten_plot_data,
  aes(x = week, y = rank, group = interaction(artist, track), color = highlight)
) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Other top-10 songs" = "gray70",
      setNames(
        scales::hue_pal()(nrow(notable_songs)),
        paste(notable_songs$artist, notable_songs$track, sep = " - ")
      )
    )
  ) +
  labs(color = "Song")
```
